import z3

def solve():
    V = 24
    E_min = 29
    
    # Adjacency matrix
    adj = [[z3.Bool(f"e_{i}_{j}") for j in range(V)] for i in range(V)]
    
    s = z3.Solver()
    
    # Undirected graph, no self loops
    for i in range(V):
        s.add(z3.Not(adj[i][i]))
        for j in range(i + 1, V):
            s.add(adj[i][j] == adj[j][i])
            
    # At least E_min edges
    edge_vars = [z3.If(adj[i][j], 1, 0) for i in range(V) for j in range(i + 1, V)]
    s.add(z3.Sum(edge_vars) >= E_min)
    
    # 3-colorable
    colors = [z3.Int(f"c_{i}") for i in range(V)]
    for i in range(V):
        s.add(colors[i] >= 0, colors[i] <= 2)
        for j in range(i + 1, V):
            s.add(z3.Implies(adj[i][j], colors[i] != colors[j]))
            
    # Girth >= 7
